name: Pebble
summary: Pebble is a mixed reality hand tracked sandbox survival game where you play as a tiny pebble with god like powers. In a world that responds to your touch, you can shape terrain, move objects, and manipulate your surroundings using only your hands. Though you are small, threats still exist as strange enemies roam the land, and survival means staying alert and using your abilities wisely. Explore, build, and reshape the world around you as a powerful force in a miniature ever changing landscape.
